# demo-python

A demo.

## Development

Install [pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com/#install), then the hooks:

```sh
pre-commit install
```

Python uses [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), which installs the Python version
pinned in `.python-version`.
